Sugar, Sugar
notes: “we listened to another request from Mark and Miranda. Chet Baker on the food theme, Sugar, Sugar.”
Chet Baker's cover of the Archies' 'Sugar, Sugar' is track 2 on his 1970 Verve album 'Blood, Chet and Tears'.

rows.title: Your Feet's Too Big
notes: “Then we went back to the early 1970s in Australia... Captain Matchbox Whoopie Band with your feats too big? That's from their Wongarata Wahine album.”
mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played
Australian jug/whoopee band's cover of the Fats Waller standard was a single from their 1974 album 'Wangaratta Wahine' (Image Records).
